column1: # The toolset the runner images carry beyond the runner itself (docs/runner-images.md): one row per
# tool, version, operating system and architecture. Tab-separated: tool, version, os, arch, checksum, url.
# The checksum is the publisher's own (sha256, or sha512 where that is what the publisher states) and the
# install refuses an archive that does not match it. A version moves only in a commit that also moves its
# checksum and its row in docs/runner-images.md. `rust` rows pin rustup-init; the version is the
# toolchain rustup then installs, which rustup checks against the channel manifest itself.
